snapshot.what_they_sell: A governed platform for building and deploying internal apps and AI agents, including a governed runtime and AI-native app builder launched 2026-06-17 that lets teams deploy AI-built apps to production with governance enforced automatically.
snapshot.who_they_sell_to: Builders plus IT and security leaders. The 2026-06-17 newsroom cites a survey of 300 C-suite executives and names Colgate-Palmolive as a customer. A Databricks case study names Wayve and Reckitt. Retool says it is trusted by over 10,000 organizations.
snapshot.size_and_stage: Founded 2017, CEO David Hsu, offices in the USA and UK. Headcount conflicts: Revelio Labs shows about 372 (March 2026) and Landed.jobs shows 418, with no company-stated figure. Last priced round was a $45M Series C2 at a $3.2B valuation in July 2022. Total raised is about $140.12M across 7 rounds (CB Insights) or about $141M across 5 rounds (Multiples). No 2026 funding round was found.

triggers.summary: Retool opened early access to a centralized agent harness for running agents in Slack, Teams and Google Chat, with admin controls over tools, data and models.
triggers.evidence_quote: We're opening early access to a centralized agent harness that lets employees work with agents in Slack, Teams, and Google Chat

pains.pain: Employees running agents in Slack, Teams and Google Chat need per-agent governance, tool and data controls, and audit as adoption scales.
pains.reasoning: The early access announcement says employees will work with agents in these channels, with admin controls over tools, data and models. That makes governance of agent access a direct concern.

pains.pain: Sales capacity gap: hiring is concentrated in engineering and AI platform roles, with no visible outbound, SDR or revenue operations openings.
pains.reasoning: Tied to the company snapshot, not a trigger. The undated careers page lists 13 engineering and 3 product roles and only 2 sales roles, a director of strategic alliances and an EMEA enterprise AE.

pains.pain: Buyer concern about vibe-coded tools running in production, cited by 93% of 300 surveyed C-suite executives.
pains.reasoning: Tied to the company snapshot. The survey and its 93% figure come from the 2026-06-17 launch, which is before the 2026-07-16 trigger window.

talk_tracks.opener: Retool's agent harness puts Slack, Teams and Google Chat agents under admin controls; how are you tracking which agents touch which data?
Retool's open roles skew engineering and AI platform, with no visible outbound or SDR hiring. Who is building pipeline for your enterprise AEs?
Your June survey found 93% of executives worry about vibe-coded tools in production. How are you reaching those owners?

confidence_notes: Search coverage of 2026-07-16 to 2026-10-14 is partial because the tool hit its limit after 5 queries. Only one trigger qualifies.
Trigger 0 is the only event in the window with a QUOTE and relevant to AI outbound, so pains 2 and 3 use -1 and are tied to the company snapshot.

Excluded as low relevance: the 2026-09-30 Retool-MongoDB credentials partnership (only the category listing was seen, post body not opened, and it is not a press release unless confirmed) and the 2026-10-14 new AI models changelog entry (a model-support update, not a sales signal).

Excluded for lack of a QUOTE: the hiring-trend items from the careers page (undated snapshot), Landed.jobs (22 open roles, 2026-10-13) and Revelio Labs (88 postings, up 9.5%). They may still inform the pain tied to the snapshot.

Leadership: Michael Blank (COO, 2026-01-13), Jordan Edelstein (Interim CMO, 2026-05-26) and Pep Guidote (VP GTM Programs, undated, possibly 3 months old) are all outside the window. Guidote's start date is unverified.
Abhishek Gupta's CPO status is unverified: a February 2026 Databricks quote conflicts with an Exa profile listing tenure ending January 2026.
Headcount conflicts (372 vs 418) and neither is company-stated. Funding round count conflicts (7 vs 5) and total raised differs slightly between sources.
The 93% survey figure and the 2026-06-17 launch are prior context before the window and were not used as triggers.
No 2026 funding round or valuation was found.
